$comment: Auralis seed twin - Vijayawada, Krishna district, Andhra Pradesh. Coordinates are real EPSG:4326 (WGS84) lon,lat. Levels are metres above MSL unless a field says otherwise; the Prakasam Barrage pond level is carried in feet because that is the unit the AP Water Resources Department operates in, and river discharge is in cusecs for the same reason. The scenario mirrors the September 2024 Budameru breach: the Budameru rivulet enters the city from Velagaleru, its diversion channel is capacity-limited to about 11,000 cusecs, and when it overtops near Ajit Singh Nagar the water runs into Singh Nagar, Payakapuram, Vidyadharapuram and Krishnalanka. Wall-clock on the wire is UTC ISO8601 with Z, per the contract. Operators read it as IST (UTC+05:30); UI labels convert, storage never does.
